scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，荣誉之厅。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
请在此处随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，荣誉之厅。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You will now end
your present life and
begin an entirely new life.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
你即将结束现在的生命，
开始全新的生活。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
There are a few things you must
do before we start. You must
first empty your mind and body.
Honor comes when you abandon
all your selfish desires...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
在开始之前，有几件事你必须做。
首先，你必须清空你的身心。
当你抛弃所有自私的欲望时，荣誉便会降临……

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You cannot take anything with you to the next life. Your items, zeny, pets and Pushcart all have to be left behind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
你无法携带任何东西进入来世。你的物品、泽尼、宠物和手推车使用都必须留下。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
When you are ready
please return to me,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
当你准备好时，
请回到我身边，
勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I see you've already
released yourself from
all worldy attachments,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
我看你已经
从所有的世俗羁绊中
<释放>了自己，
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
That's an admirable attitude for an adventurer such as yourself. Honor comes when you abandon all personal desires for the sake of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
对于像你这样的冒险者来说，这是一种令人钦佩的态度。为了人类的利益而放弃个人欲望时，荣誉便会降临。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Hmm... I sense that you have
some lingering attachment or
unfinished business in your
current life. Take care of that,
and bring closure to your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
嗯……我感觉到你在
目前的生活中还有一些
未了的牵挂或
未完成的事情。处理好那些事，
为你现在的生活画上句号。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Now, let me remove all
of your present memories...
However, you will be able to
remember the most honorable
moments of this life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
现在，让我移除你
目前的所有记忆……
不过，你将能够
记住这一生中最荣耀的
时刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With one,
I will ask the
goddess Urd to remove
all of your present
memories.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一，
我将请求女神乌尔德移除
你所有的现有
记忆。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With two,
I will ask the
goddess Verdandi to keep
and record the most honorable moments of your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
二，
我将请求女神薇儿丹蒂保留
并记录你现有生活中
最荣耀的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With three,
I will ask the
goddess Skuld to
guide you to your
next life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
三，
我将请求女神诗寇蒂
引导你走向
你的来世。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一……

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一……
二……

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......
And Three.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一……
二……
以及三。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Congratulations.
You are now reborn
into a brand new life.
Please take these small gifts
in preparation for your new adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
恭喜。
你现在重生为
崭新的生命。
请收下这些小礼物，
为你新的冒险做准备。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I wish that the release the goddess Urd has granted you proves to be a blessing. I hope that the memories Verdandi has recorded will always honor you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
我希望女神乌尔德给予你的<释放>证明是一种祝福。我希望薇儿丹蒂记录的记忆将永远为你带来荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
And I pray that the new life to which the goddess Skuld will guide you will be even more honorable than your last.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
我祈祷女神诗寇蒂将引导你前往的新生活，比你上一世更加荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，荣誉之厅。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Unfortunately, you have not yet been invited here. I ask you to leave immediately. Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
很遗憾，你尚未被邀请至此。我请你立即离开。向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I assume you have come here
to read the 'Book of Ymir.'
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施维彻比尔魔法学院图书馆。
我想你是来这里
阅读《尤米尔之书》的。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, the original copy of the book has been damaged over time. We currently only allow the public to view a copy of the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，原版的书籍因时间久远而受损。我们目前只允许公众观看该书的副本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Also, in order to preserve the original 'Book of Ymir,' we have decided to accept donations from people who wish to read the copy we have provided.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
此外，为了<自由保护>原版《尤米尔之书》，我们决定接受希望阅读我们所提供副本的人们的捐赠。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The suggested
donation amount is
1,285,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
建议的
捐赠金额为
1,285,000泽尼。

scripts.text: Donate.
scripts.translation: 捐赠。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Thank you, your donation will be used for a good cause. You may
now go in and read the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
谢谢，你的捐赠将用于有益的事业。你现在可以进去阅读这本书了。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, you don't seem to possess enough zeny at the moment. Please check your funds and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，你目前似乎没有足够的泽尼。请检查你的资金后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Take your time, and
enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
慢慢来，
享受你的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Once again, thank you for your generous donation. Feel free to read a carbon copy of the 'Book of Ymir' at your leisure.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
再次感谢你慷慨的捐赠。请随意阅读《尤米尔之书》的复写本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Here, we have a countless number of books. Please take your time and look around.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施维彻比尔魔法学院图书馆。
这里有无数的书籍。请慢慢参观。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...The entrance to the Hall of Honor is open to anyone who has moved forward into their next life. It is there to help heroes decide what they want to do, and can lead them to anywhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
……任何转生到来世的人都可以进入荣誉之厅。它帮助英雄们决定他们想做什么，并能引导他们前往这个世界的任何地方。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
In the Hall of Honor, everything is prepared for heroes. It is rumored that any wish that cannot be fulfilled in our reality can be realized in the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
在荣誉之厅里，一切都为英雄们准备就绪。传闻在我们现实中无法实现的任何愿望，都可以在荣誉之厅中实现。

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止阅读。

scripts.text: Continue reading.
scripts.translation: 继续阅读。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
.....
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There is a forgotten path which leads to the Hall of Honor, the closest place to the heavens. The ordinary will never discover this place...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
有一条被遗忘的道路通向荣誉之厅，那是离天堂最近的地方。普通人永远不会发现这个地方……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...Therefore, ancient heroes were
always in anguish, knowing that
eventually, they were mortal and
would pass from this realm...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
……因此，古代的英雄们总是处于痛苦之中，因为他们知道最终自己是凡人，并将离开这个领域……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There were no documents,
songs, or remaining folklore that had any information on life after death. However, I recently uncovered an old scroll
about Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
没有任何文献、歌曲或留存的民间传说包含关于死后生活的<资讯>。然而，我最近发现了一卷关于瓦尔基里的古旧卷轴……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Valkyrie...
The legendary
guardian angel.
Angel of Ragnarok.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
瓦尔基里……
传奇的
守护天使。
仙境传说的天使。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Adventurers of great strength
and bravery will be lead by
Valkyrie to Valhalla, the Hall
of Honor. There, they will be
given a new life.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
强大而勇敢的冒险者将被瓦尔基里引导至英灵殿，即荣誉之厅。在那里，他们将获得新的生命。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Reborn, they will live again as
even greater heroes that will
brighten the world. Bodies that
were exhausted will be filled
with energy...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
重生后，他们将作为更伟大的英雄再次生活，照亮世界。疲惫的身体将充满<能量>……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
And their souls will be given abilities with the heart of Ymir. However, the heart of Ymir was totally destroyed and scattered all over the world after the battle for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
他们的灵魂将被赋予拥有尤米尔之心的能力。然而，尤米尔之心在卢恩·米德加兹之战后被彻底摧毁并散落在世界各地。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
I have found a small amount of
Ymir heart pieces over a long
long period of time. But I can't
confirm if the story of Valkyrie
and Valhalla is true just
through scientific tests.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
我在很长的时间里找到了少量的尤米尔之心碎片。但我无法仅通过科学测试来确认瓦尔基里和英灵殿的故事是否真实。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
So, I am leaving this record in hope that someone in the future
can confirm that Valkyrie and Valhalla actually exist...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
所以，我留下这份记录，希望未来有人能确认瓦尔基里和英灵殿确实存在……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Let the heroes live new lives
so they can protect the world
from danger. And then...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
让英雄们过上新的生活，
以便他们能保护世界
免受危险。然后……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
……

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
……

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Please refrain
from touching any
of the exhibitions.
..........
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
请勿触摸
任何展品。
………

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Honorable one,
which place do you wish to go?
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
尊贵之人，
你想去哪个地方？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 摩洛克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰

scripts.text: Comodo
scripts.translation: 克魔岛

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Have a nice trip.
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
祝你旅途愉快。
